qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate dc2c32f and serialized fix rechecks of a4c7616 found the original correctness, comprehensibility, consistency and quiz-safety defects resolved. 譲る now confines its 負ける contrast to the seat example and acknowledges 負ける's «уступать, поддаваться» and «снижать цену» senses; 読み's closing note says only that 読書 «чтение книг» names the activity and lacks the pronunciation and situation-assessment senses; RU-only sentences describing test behaviour were removed from 講演 and 招く while their linguistic distinctions remain. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 22 EN exclusions across 15 lists are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received 16 direct, one-sided exclusions: 譲る–負ける; 議論–相談/話し合う/論じる; 講演–スピーチ; 話し合う–相談; 調査–調べる; 読み–読む; 説–説明; 語学–勉強; 語る–話/話す; 招く–招待/呼ぶ; 誘う–招待/呼ぶ. Nine were added after review: 議論–話し合う, 議論–論じる, 調査–調べる, 読み–読む, 説–説明, 語学–勉強, 語る–話す, 招く–呼ぶ and 誘う–呼ぶ. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.
